notes.title: New DLC Teil 4"Interlude"：Arriving this March 1st at 17:00 PST
notes.content:
Dear fans,

[b]The Case Book of Arne Teil 4 "Interlude,"[/b] the epilogue to Case 1 comes to Steam as a $2.99 DLC!
Lynn struggles to acclimate to living with Arne. 
[b]A festival for monsters beckons to her-- plenty of fun minigames, 
fortunes, and a moving development![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835820/e442e56982ef51a8d2dbfca899b49aada25d43c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835820/89d9373c3922440a865e525fe31d9db9876645d1.png[/img]

You'll find plenty of minigames at the festival. 
For instance, keep up a rock-paper-scissors
win streak using special character cards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835820/6c37c94fdc14a08de2f0014c3f9b3538219f4397.png[/img]


See you there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1322290/


Vaka Game Magazine / PLAYISM
